@graph.description: Identifies high-frequency aptamer candidate sequences from paired-end SELEX FASTQ files. Each read mate is processed independently through three sequential filtering stages and survivors are pooled: (1) matching/orientation by left and right constant regions with configurable mismatch tolerance, checking both strands; (2) flanking extraction of the region between inner LCR and RCR markers by exact match; (3) random-region (N) extraction requiring exact stem matches and an exact target length. Each stage's surviving sequences are aggregated by identical sequence and ranked by count (descending, with first-seen tie-breaking). Outputs ranked TSVs for the raw reads and each stage plus a survival summary. All pattern sequences, mismatch tolerances and lengths are user-configurable. This version parallelizes stages 1-3 across worker processes (order-preserving, byte-identical outputs), speeds up mismatch-tolerant matching with a pigeonhole seed-and-verify search, and adds timestamped progress logging to stderr.
@graph.name: AptaSelect
